# Trailmark Insurance Advisors

> Trailmark Insurance Advisors is an independent, Texas-owned insurance agency in Denton, Texas. Insurance advisor Eric Glenn compares auto, home, renters, condo and townhome, motorcycle, landlord, jewelry, umbrella, boat, business and RV insurance from multiple insurance companies for families and businesses in Denton County, the Dallas–Fort Worth area and throughout Texas. Quotes and coverage reviews are free.

## Key facts
- Business name: Trailmark Insurance Advisors
- Type: Independent insurance agency (works with multiple carriers, not a captive agent of one company)
- Advisor: Eric Glenn, Insurance Advisor
- Address: 3616 Duchess Dr, Ste. 120, Denton, TX 76205
- Phone: (214) 531-7932
- Email: eric@texastrailmark.com
- Website: https://texastrailmark.com/
- Phone hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Time
- Office visits: By appointment only
- Cost to work with us: Free. No fee for quotes, advice or coverage reviews; the agency is paid a commission by the insurance company the client chooses.
- Pricing: Insurance premiums are set by each carrier and depend on the person, property and coverage. We do not publish prices; request a free quote for exact pricing.
- Service area: Denton, Corinth, Lake Dallas, Hickory Creek, Argyle, Flower Mound, Highland Village, Lewisville, Little Elm, Aubrey, Sanger, Krum, Justin, Northlake, Prosper, Frisco, The Colony, Carrollton, and all of Texas
- Get a quote: https://texastrailmark.com/contact/#quote

## Insurance products
- [Auto Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/auto-insurance/): Liability, full coverage and everything in between, with discounts for safe drivers, multiple vehicles and bundling.
- [Home Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/home-insurance/): Protect your house, belongings and liability against Texas hail, wind, fire and theft with the right deductible for you.
- [Renters Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/renters-insurance/): Affordable coverage for your belongings and personal liability, often just a few dollars a month when bundled with auto.
- [Townhome & Condo Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/condo-insurance/): Coverage built for shared walls and HOAs: your interior, upgrades, belongings and liability, plus loss assessment protection.
- [Motorcycle Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/motorcycle-insurance/): Coverage for cruisers, sport bikes and touring bikes, including custom parts, riding gear and roadside help.
- [Landlord Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/landlord-insurance/): Rental property coverage for homes and duplexes: dwelling, lost rent and landlord liability in one policy.
- [Jewelry Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/jewelry-insurance/): Protect engagement rings, watches and heirlooms against loss, theft and damage at their full appraised value.
- [Umbrella Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/umbrella-insurance/): Extra liability protection above your auto and home limits, so one bad day doesn't put everything you've built at risk.
- [Boat Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/boat-insurance/): Coverage for pontoons, bass boats, ski boats and jet skis, on the water, on the trailer or in storage.
- [Business Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/business-insurance/): General liability, commercial property, business auto, BOPs and workers' comp for small businesses and contractors.
- [RV Insurance](https://texastrailmark.com/products/rv-insurance/): Coverage for motorhomes, travel trailers and fifth wheels, from weekend camping trips to full-time RV living.

## Frequently asked questions
**Q: What is an independent insurance agency?**
A: An independent insurance agency works with multiple insurance companies instead of just one. That means Trailmark can compare coverage and prices from several carriers and recommend the policy that fits you best, rather than selling a single company's products.

**Q: Does it cost anything to work with Trailmark?**
A: No. There's no fee for quotes, coverage reviews or advice. Like most independent agencies, we're paid a commission by the insurance company you choose, so working with us doesn't add a fee on top of your premium.

**Q: What types of insurance do you offer?**
A: We help with auto, home, renters, townhome and condo, motorcycle, landlord, jewelry, umbrella, boat, business and RV insurance. See all of them on our Our Products page.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: Our office is in Denton, and we serve Denton County and the greater Dallas–Fort Worth area, including Corinth, Lake Dallas, Argyle, Flower Mound, Highland Village, Lewisville, Little Elm, Aubrey, Sanger, Krum, Prosper and Frisco. Because so much can be handled by phone and email, we can help clients throughout Texas.

**Q: Where is your office, and can I stop by?**
A: Our office is at 3616 Duchess Dr, Ste. 120, Denton, TX 76205. Office visits are by appointment only, so please call or email to schedule a time to meet in person.

**Q: What are your hours?**
A: Eric is available by phone Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. In-person office visits are by appointment. You can request a quote online anytime.

**Q: How long does it take to get a quote?**
A: Most quotes can be started in about 10 minutes. Simple policies like auto, renters and home can often be quoted the same day. Business and specialty policies may take a little longer because we gather more details.

**Q: What information do I need for a quote?**
A: For auto insurance: driver's license numbers, vehicle information (or VINs) and your current policy, if you have one. For home insurance: your address, the home's approximate age and square footage, and roof age. Your current declarations page is the most helpful document of all.

**Q: Can you review my current insurance policy?**
A: Yes, and it's free. Send us your current declarations page and we'll explain what you have, point out any gaps and show you whether we can find better coverage or a better price.

**Q: Will switching insurance companies leave me uninsured?**
A: No. We set up your new policy to start the same day your old one ends, or we help you cancel the old policy after the new one is active, so there's no gap in coverage.

**Q: Do you help with claims?**
A: Yes. Claims are filed with your insurance company, but we're here to guide you through the process, answer questions and advocate for you when you need it most.

**Q: How can I save money on insurance?**
A: Bundling home and auto is one of the biggest ways to save. Other common discounts include multi-car, safe driver, good student, claims-free, new roof, security systems and paying in full. We'll look for every discount you qualify for.

**Q: Do you insure businesses?**
A: Yes. We help small businesses, contractors, salons, pet groomers, restaurants, retail shops and professional offices with general liability, business owner's policies, commercial property, commercial auto, workers' compensation and more. Learn more about business insurance.

**Q: How do I get started?**
A: Call (214) 531-7932, email eric@texastrailmark.com or fill out our free quote form. We usually respond within one business day.
